profile.name: National Bank of Greece S.A.
profile.summary: National Bank of Greece S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides banking, financial products, and services primarily in Greece, Cyprus, North Macedonia, Romania, Bulgaria, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates through Retail Banking, Corporate & Investment Banking, Trouble Assets Units, Global Markets and Asset Management, International Banking Operations, and other segments. The Retail Banking segment provides deposit, investment, bancassurance products, mortgage loans, consumer and small business lending, debit and credit cards, prepaid cards, and other traditional products and services for individual customers, professionals, and small-medium and small sized companies through its network of branches and digital businesses. Its Corporate & Investment Banking segment offers financial and investment advisory services, deposit accounts, loans, foreign exchange, and trade services for corporate customers; and lending services for large and medium-sized companies, as well as shipping finance services. The Trouble Assets Unit segment manages various non-performing and denounced loans. Its Global Markets and Asset Management segment is involved in treasury activities; and asset management, custody, private equity, and brokerage services. The International Banking Operations segment offers traditional commercial banking, such as commercial and retail credit, trade financing, foreign exchange, and deposits; shipping finance; investment banking; and brokerage services. Its Other segment engages in the real estate management and warehousing businesses. It also provides factoring, capital markets, mutual fund management, and insurance brokerage services. National Bank of Greece S.A. was founded in 1841 and is headquartered in Athens, Greece.
profile.summary_fr: National Bank of Greece S.A., avec ses filiales, fournit des services bancaires, des produits financiers et des services principalement en Grèce, à Chypre, en Macédoine du Nord, en Roumanie, en Bulgarie, au Luxembourg, aux Pays-Bas et au Royaume-Uni, ainsi qu'à l'international. Il opère par le biais de la banque de détail, de la banque de financement et d’investissement, des unités d’actifs problématiques, des marchés mondiaux et de la gestion d’actifs, des opérations bancaires internationales et d’autres segments. Le secteur de la banque de détail fournit des produits de dépôt, d'investissement, de bancassurance, des prêts hypothécaires, des prêts aux consommateurs et aux petites entreprises, des cartes de débit et de crédit, des cartes prépayées et d'autres produits et services traditionnels pour les clients individuels, les professionnels et les petites et moyennes entreprises par le biais de son réseau de succursales et d'entreprises numériques.
